criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 10 March 2029 (18 months after the 10 September 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Netherby Industries Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $27,600,000 but 10% of the $230,000,000 Purchase Price is $23,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $229,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $228,760,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (10% x $230,000,000 = $23,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $27,600,000.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (10 March 2029), with days remaining from 22 June 2027 (627 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
